from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
t=Path("Coder/domain-model.md").read_text()
front=t.split("---",2)[1]
assert all(k in front for k in ("title:","audience:","scope:"))
ctx=t.split("## 3. 限界上下文地图",1)[1].split("## 4.",1)[0]
ctx_rows=[x for x in ctx.splitlines() if x.startswith("| ")][1:]
assert len(ctx_rows)==5
audit=t.split("## 4. 统一语言审计",1)[1].split("## 5.",1)[0]
rows=[x for x in audit.splitlines() if x.startswith("| ")][1:]
assert len(rows)==20 and all(len(x.split("|"))==10 for x in rows)
paths=set(re.findall(r"`((?:Coder|tools|\\.ai)/[^`]+)`", t))
assert not [x for x in paths if not Path(x.split(" §",1)[0]).exists()]
assert "Dangerous Mode 与 Convergence Loop" in t and "人测残余" in t
names=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","--","Coder"],text=True).split()) | {"Coder/domain-model.md"}
assert names=={"Coder/domain-model.md","Coder/README.md","Coder/architecture-overview.md"}
print(f"PASS contexts={len(ctx_rows)} audit_terms={len(rows)} source_paths={len(paths)}")
